detail.policy: random42 and random122 are different random partitions of the same 4,200-molecule Lipophilicity table; no per-molecule pairing or pooled metric is computed across them.

detail.isomorphism_test: networkx VF2 with node label and bond-type matching

detail.interpretation: positive d_i means PNA has the smaller squared error

policy.invalid_smiles_policy: recorded with parse_ok=False and NaN descriptors; never dropped silently, and never included in a pairwise prediction comparison
policy.multi_component_policy: kept as one disconnected molecular graph (no salt stripping, no fragment selection); rooted balls stay inside one component; descriptors sum over the whole record
policy.empty_scaffold_policy: acyclic molecules have an empty Bemis-Murcko scaffold; the canonical isomeric-free SMILES is used as the scaffold key and scaffold_fallback_used=True is recorded

blocking_policy: Any metric reproduction |diff| > 1e-5 blocks the corresponding analysis; Test is POST_HOC_EXPOSED_DISCOVERY and never selects a checkpoint.
